technical.zh-CN: 该条为联合展区，官方称包含 48 家央企、260 余件展品和 25 个应用场景；本资料库只计一条原始记录，未擅自拆为 48 条企业档案。
technical.en: This is a joint exhibit claiming 48 central enterprises, over 260 exhibits and 25 application settings. The source library counts one original record and does not split it into 48 company profiles.
